newsitem.title: POLAND: Two Polish girls confess to killing classmate.
newsitem.headline: Two Polish girls confess to killing classmate.

text.p: Two 14-year-old Polish girls have confessed to stabbing a classmate to death in the southwestern Polish city of Wroclaw, a police spokesman said on Monday.

"They said they invited their friend for a walk along the river and then stabbed her a number of times in the chest and stomach with a hunting knife," PAP news agency quoted police spokesman Stanislaw Stygar as saying. The motive for the crime was not immediately clear.
